name: k8s_job
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Job — a batch workload that runs one or more containers to completion within an environment or resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Kubernetes job.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes job resource.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the job runs.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the job runs.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace to run the job in.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs inherited from the linked environment or resource group.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Labels to apply to the Kubernetes Job object.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Annotations to apply to the Kubernetes Job object.

attributes.name: backoff_limit
attributes.description: Number of retries before the job is marked as failed. Defaults to 6.

attributes.name: completions
attributes.description: Number of pods that must succeed for the job to be considered complete.

attributes.name: parallelism
attributes.description: Maximum number of pods running in parallel at any time.

attributes.name: ttl_seconds_after_finished
attributes.description: Seconds after the job finishes before it is automatically deleted. Omit to disable automatic cleanup.

attributes.name: active_deadline_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum duration in seconds the job may run before being terminated.

attributes.name: suspend
attributes.description: When true, the job is suspended and no new pods are created.

attributes.name: restart_policy
attributes.description: Pod restart policy. Use Never (default) or OnFailure for batch jobs.

attributes.name: service_account_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes service account to run the pod as.

attributes.name: node_selector
attributes.description: Node label selector constraints for pod scheduling.

attributes.name: containers
attributes.description: List of containers to run in each job pod.

attributes.name: image_pull_policy
attributes.description: Image pull policy: Always, IfNotPresent, or Never.

attributes.name: container_port
attributes.description: Port number the container listens on.

attributes.name: env
attributes.description: Environment variables. Set value for a literal, or value_from to source from a Secret/ConfigMap key or pod field.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Literal variable value. Mutually exclusive with value_from.

attributes.name: value_from
attributes.description: Source the value from a Secret/ConfigMap key or pod/container field. Mutually exclusive with value.

attributes.name: secret_key_ref
attributes.description: Reference a key in a Secret.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.description: Whether the Secret or key must exist.

attributes.name: config_map_key_ref
attributes.description: Reference a key in a ConfigMap.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.description: Whether the ConfigMap or key must exist.

attributes.name: field_ref
attributes.description: Reference a field of the pod (e.g. metadata.name, status.podIP).

attributes.name: field_path
attributes.description: Path of the field, e.g. metadata.namespace.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: API version the field path is evaluated against (default v1).

attributes.name: resource_field_ref
attributes.description: Reference a container resource (e.g. limits.cpu, requests.memory).

attributes.name: container_name
attributes.description: Container to read the resource from (defaults to this container).

attributes.name: env_from
attributes.description: Populate environment variables in bulk from entire ConfigMaps or Secrets.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Prefix prepended to each key's environment variable name.

attributes.name: config_map_ref
attributes.description: Load all keys from a ConfigMap.

attributes.name: secret_ref
attributes.description: Load all keys from a Secret.

attributes.name: liveness_probe
attributes.description: Probe that restarts the container when it fails.

attributes.name: initial_delay_seconds
attributes.description: Seconds after container start before the first probe.

attributes.name: period_seconds
attributes.description: How often to run the probe (seconds).

attributes.name: success_threshold
attributes.description: Consecutive successes to be considered healthy.

attributes.name: host
attributes.description: Host to connect to (defaults to pod IP).

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Command to run inside the container.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: gRPC service name for the health check.

attributes.name: readiness_probe
attributes.description: Probe that removes the pod from Service endpoints when it fails.

attributes.name: initial_delay_seconds
attributes.description: Seconds after container start before the first probe.

attributes.name: period_seconds
attributes.description: How often to run the probe (seconds).

attributes.name: success_threshold
attributes.description: Consecutive successes to be considered ready.

attributes.name: host
attributes.description: Host to connect to (defaults to pod IP).

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Command to run inside the container.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: gRPC service name for the health check.

attributes.name: startup_probe
attributes.description: Probe that gates liveness/readiness until the container has started.

attributes.name: initial_delay_seconds
attributes.description: Seconds after container start before the first probe.

attributes.name: period_seconds
attributes.description: How often to run the probe (seconds).

attributes.name: success_threshold
attributes.description: Consecutive successes to be considered started.

attributes.name: host
attributes.description: Host to connect to (defaults to pod IP).

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Command to run inside the container.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: gRPC service name for the health check.

attributes.name: volume_mounts
attributes.description: Mount pod volumes into the container filesystem.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the pod volume to mount.

attributes.name: mount_path
attributes.description: Path inside the container to mount at.

attributes.name: sub_path
attributes.description: Mount a sub-path of the volume instead of its root.

attributes.name: sub_path_expr
attributes.description: Like sub_path but expanded with environment variables.

attributes.name: volume_devices
attributes.description: Raw block devices to map into the container.

attributes.name: device_path
attributes.description: Path inside the container to map the device to.

attributes.name: run_as_user
attributes.description: UID to run the entrypoint as.

attributes.name: run_as_group
attributes.description: GID to run the entrypoint as.

attributes.name: run_as_non_root
attributes.description: Require the container to run as a non-root user.

attributes.name: allow_privilege_escalation
attributes.description: Allow a process to gain more privileges than its parent.

attributes.name: capabilities
attributes.description: Linux capabilities to add or drop.

attributes.name: localhost_profile
attributes.description: Profile file path (used when type is Localhost).

attributes.name: post_start
attributes.description: Hook run immediately after the container starts.

attributes.name: pre_stop
attributes.description: Hook run immediately before the container is stopped.

attributes.name: termination_message_path
attributes.description: File from which the container's termination message is read.

attributes.name: termination_message_policy
attributes.description: How the termination message is populated.

attributes.name: stdin
attributes.description: Allocate a buffer for stdin in the container.

attributes.name: stdin_once
attributes.description: Close the stdin channel after the first attach disconnects.

attributes.name: tty
attributes.description: Allocate a TTY for the container.

attributes.name: image_pull_secrets
attributes.description: Image pull secrets referenced by the pods, for pulling container images from private registries.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret (type kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson) in the same namespace used to pull images from a private registry.

attributes.name: init_containers
attributes.description: Init containers that run to completion, in order, before the main containers start.

attributes.name: value_from
attributes.description: Source the value from a Secret/ConfigMap key or pod field.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.description: Whether the Secret or key must exist.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.description: Whether the ConfigMap or key must exist.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: API version for the field path.

attributes.name: config_map_ref
attributes.description: Load all keys from a ConfigMap.

attributes.name: secret_ref
attributes.description: Load all keys from a Secret.

attributes.name: volumes
attributes.description: Pod volumes that containers can mount via volume_mounts.

attributes.name: config_map
attributes.description: Populate the volume from a ConfigMap.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Specific keys to project to paths.

attributes.name: secret
attributes.description: Populate the volume from a Secret.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Specific keys to project to paths.

attributes.name: empty_dir
attributes.description: Ephemeral scratch volume tied to the pod lifetime.

attributes.name: host_path
attributes.description: Mount a file or directory from the host node.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Host path type (e.g. Directory, DirectoryOrCreate, File).

attributes.name: csi
attributes.description: Mount a volume via a CSI driver.

attributes.name: tolerations
attributes.description: Tolerations that allow the pod onto tainted nodes.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: Taint effect to match (empty matches all).

attributes.name: toleration_seconds
attributes.description: How long to tolerate a NoExecute taint before eviction.

attributes.name: topology_spread_constraints
attributes.description: Rules for spreading pods across topology domains (zones, nodes).

attributes.name: max_skew
attributes.description: Maximum permitted difference in pod count between domains.

attributes.name: topology_key
attributes.description: Node label defining the topology domain (e.g. topology.kubernetes.io/zone).

attributes.name: when_unsatisfiable
attributes.description: Action when the constraint cannot be met.

attributes.name: affinity
attributes.description: Node/pod affinity and anti-affinity scheduling rules.

attributes.name: pod_affinity
attributes.description: Co-locate with pods matching a label selector.

attributes.name: topology_key
attributes.description: Node label defining the topology domain.

attributes.name: pod_anti_affinity
attributes.description: Avoid scheduling near pods matching a label selector.

attributes.name: topology_key
attributes.description: Node label defining the topology domain.

attributes.name: pod_security_context
attributes.description: Pod-level security settings applied to all containers.

attributes.name: run_as_non_root
attributes.description: Require containers to run as non-root.

attributes.name: fs_group
attributes.description: Supplemental group applied to mounted volumes.

attributes.name: fs_group_change_policy
attributes.description: When to change volume ownership to fs_group.

attributes.name: supplemental_groups
attributes.description: Additional GIDs for the first container process.

attributes.name: termination_grace_period_seconds
attributes.description: Seconds the pod is given to shut down gracefully before being force-killed.

attributes.name: dns_config
attributes.description: Custom DNS settings, merged per dns_policy.

attributes.name: host_aliases
attributes.description: Additional /etc/hosts entries injected into the pod.

attributes.name: share_process_namespace
attributes.description: Share a single process namespace between all containers in the pod.

attributes.name: priority_class_name
attributes.description: PriorityClass name used to set the pod's scheduling priority.

attributes.name: scheduler_name
attributes.description: Name of the scheduler that dispatches the pod.

attributes.name: runtime_class_name
attributes.description: RuntimeClass to use for the pod (e.g. gvisor).

attributes.name: hostname
attributes.description: Pod hostname (defaults to the pod name).

attributes.name: subdomain
attributes.description: Pod subdomain, used with a headless Service for stable DNS.

attributes.name: automount_service_account_token
attributes.description: Whether to automount the service account token into the pod.

attributes.name: enable_service_links
attributes.description: Inject service discovery environment variables for services in the namespace.

attributes.name: set_hostname_as_fqdn
attributes.description: Set the pod's hostname to its fully qualified domain name.

attributes.name: max_failed_indexes
attributes.description: Max number of failed indexes before the job is failed (Indexed jobs only).

attributes.name: pod_replacement_policy
attributes.description: When to create replacement pods: TerminatingOrFailed or Failed.

attributes.name: pod_failure_policy
attributes.description: Rules that determine how pod failures are handled.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Action taken when the rule matches.

attributes.name: container_name
attributes.description: Restrict to this container (defaults to all).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the job resource.

attributes.name: k8s_job_id
attributes.description: ID of this job, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: job_active
attributes.description: Number of pods actively running for the job.

attributes.name: job_succeeded
attributes.description: Number of pods that have successfully completed.

attributes.name: job_failed
attributes.description: Number of pods that have failed.
